headline: Warehouse Manager/Material Handler
workPreference: Warehouse & Fulfillment, Shipping & Receiving, Material Handling, Production
summary: Experienced warehouse and production professional with over a decade of hands-on experience in material handling, shipping and receiving, inventory management, and production environments.
